note: All policies, rates and fees below are invented for the prototype. 'Joint account' is deliberately missing so the enquiry branch must route REQ-040 to a human instead of guessing.

entries.question: What is the BSB for the Melbourne CBD branch?
entries.answer: The BSB for our Melbourne CBD branch (333 Collins Street) is 063-501.

entries.question: What is the BSB for the Docklands branch?
entries.answer: The BSB for our Docklands branch (800 Bourke Street) is 063-522.

entries.question: Where can I find my BSB?
entries.answer: Your BSB is shown under 'Account details' in the app and at the top of every statement.

entries.question: What interest rate does the Online Saver pay?
entries.answer: The Online Saver pays a base rate of 1.50% p.a. plus a bonus 3.25% p.a. in any month you deposit at least $200 and make no withdrawals, for a total of 4.75% p.a.

entries.question: Are there fees for using my debit card overseas?
entries.answer: Purchases in a foreign currency attract a 3% international transaction fee. Overseas ATM withdrawals cost $5 plus any fee charged by the ATM operator.

entries.question: Do I need to tell you before I travel?
entries.answer: No travel notice is needed. Make sure your mobile number is up to date so we can contact you about unusual activity.

entries.question: How do I set up a PayID with my mobile number?
entries.answer: In the app go to Settings > PayID > Create PayID, choose your mobile number, confirm with the code we text you, and link it to the account you want payments to go to.

entries.question: Is the Chadstone branch open on Saturdays?
entries.answer: Yes. The Chadstone branch is open Saturday 9am to 1pm, and Monday to Friday 9:30am to 5pm.

entries.question: What are standard branch hours?
entries.answer: Most branches are open Monday to Friday 9:30am to 4pm. Check the branch finder in the app for Saturday trading.

entries.question: What is the minimum term deposit and can I withdraw early?
entries.answer: The minimum term deposit is $5,000. You can withdraw early with 31 days' notice, and an interest adjustment applies.

entries.question: How do I check my credit card rewards points?
entries.answer: Your points balance is shown on the credit card screen in the app under 'Rewards', and on your monthly statement.

entries.question: What should I do if my card is lost or stolen?
entries.answer: Lock the card immediately in the app under Cards > Lock card, then call our 24/7 line on 13 00 00 to cancel it and order a replacement.

entries.question: How long do transfers take?
entries.answer: Transfers to PayID and most accounts via the New Payments Platform arrive within a minute. Other transfers usually arrive within one business day.

entries.question: How do I get old statements?
entries.answer: Statements from the last seven years are available in the app under Accounts > Statements. You can download them as PDFs.

entries.question: What can I do if I'm having trouble making repayments?
entries.answer: Contact our Financial Hardship team as early as possible. We will respond in writing within 21 days and work with you on options such as reduced repayments or a short pause.
